sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study
protocolPurpose: Pre-register the first narrow NHATS functional-survival estimand before data download, extraction scripts, variable selection, calibration, validation or Web display.

currentDecision.reason: The estimand question and analysis boundary are pre-registered, but registration, exact variables, missing codes, weights, endpoint fields, cohort flow, disclosure control and governed storage remain incomplete.

estimand.label: Adjacent-round aggregate functional-survival state
estimand.question: Among eligible NHATS sample persons represented in the Round 13 public-use annual file, what is the aggregate Round 14 functional-survival state after freezing baseline predictors at Round 13?

targetPopulation.ageFrame: Age 65+ NHATS sample persons represented by the selected public-use annual file family.
inclusionCriteria: present in governed R13 public-use annual file after registration
eligible for R14 adjacent-round follow-up classification
has required design, identity and interview-route variables after official confirmation
exclusionCriteria: records requiring sensitive or restricted files in the first pass
rows whose endpoint, interview route or residential state cannot be classified from approved public-use fields
rows that would create small-cell disclosure risk in aggregate outputs

timeZero.indexRule: Freeze predictors at the R13 interview state after confirming official variable names and missing codes.
timeZero.predictorLookbackWindow: R13 interview content only unless a field is explicitly pre-registered as historical baseline context.
timeZero.followupStart: Immediately after the R13 baseline state.

outcomeDefinition.forbiddenOutcome: individual death date or personal life expectancy.

predictorFamilies.role: join, round, cohort, interview route and survey design readiness
predictorFamilies.sourceFamily: R13/R14 public annual files plus official methods documentation
self-care, mobility, household activities and medical-care activity families

predictorFamilies.role: baseline cognition, memory and measurement route state
predictorFamilies.sourceFamily: direct cognition, proxy cognition and route indicators
household, helper, insurance, economic and care-support families
home environment, transportation, technology and service-access families

mustDistinguish: not classifiable from public-use first-pass variables
censoringAndMissingness.rule: Each row must be routed to outcome, censoring, proxy/residential route or not-classifiable before any model metric is computed.

surveyDesignPlan.blockedUntil: Blocked until exact design and weight variables are confirmed from official methods documentation, codebooks or Colectica.

analysisPlan.modelClassBoundary: screening / descriptive-predictive protocol only until governed data and validation exist

readinessGates.requiredEvidence: Registered NHATS access and permitted user boundary recorded outside the public repository.
One canonical public-use annual file format selected for R13/R14.
Exact field names, labels, value labels, missing codes and question text confirmed from Colectica, codebooks or official crosswalks.
Death, proxy, residential care, nonresponse and not-classifiable routes mapped to official fields.
Weight, strata, cluster/PSU and variance method fixed.
Small-cell suppression and aggregate-only export validator implemented.
Non-public storage, access log, raw/derived boundary and destruction-on-request process defined.

nextWork: Select one canonical R13/R14 public annual file format after registration.
Use Colectica, codebooks or official crosswalks to fill exact variables and missing codes for each predictor and outcome family.
Write a cohort-flow template before any extraction script exists.
Implement disclosure-control and governed-storage checks before any derived output leaves the workspace.
